reuse.why: The new rule is added as isFixedGroup inside the existing shouldFillCategory in fill-rules.ts, which every month-wide action already consults.

duplication.why: The decision is not duplicated, but the same 'LEFT JOIN notes gn ON gn.id = g.id' plus group_notes column and type extension is pasted into six near-identical category queries in actions.ts instead of factoring that query.

placement.why: The predicate lives in fill-rules.ts, the module documented as the single definition of which categories month-wide actions fill.

scope.why: Only the fixed-group predicate and the data it needs are touched.

maintainability.why: One rule definition is easy to own; the six hand-maintained queries that must each carry group_notes are the weak spot (a seventh action could silently miss the join).

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions keep going through shouldFillCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated join/column additions in actions.ts are literal copies across the existing duplicated queries, not reshaped logic.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/fill-rules.ts shouldFillCategory -> isFixedGroup, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3MonthAvg, setLastMonthSpending, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg (each query must still supply group_notes).
